mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROCUREMENT_NOTIFICATION (ID, RECIPIENT_USER_ID, PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NAME, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, OPERATOR_NAME, OPINION, READ_FLAG, CREATED_TIME, READ_TIME) VALUES (#{id},#{recipientUserId},#{projectId},#{projectName},#{type},#{title},#{content},#{operatorName},#{opinion},#{readFlag},#{createdTime},#{readTime})
mapper.select: SELECT ID, RECIPIENT_USER_ID, PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NAME, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, OPERATOR_NAME, OPINION, READ_FLAG, CREATED_TIME, READ_TIME FROM PROCUREMENT_NOTIFICATION WHERE RECIPIENT_USER_ID=#{userId} AND READ_FLAG=0 ORDER BY CREATED_TIME DESC, ID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE PROCUREMENT_NOTIFICATION SET READ_FLAG=1, READ_TIME=#{readTime} WHERE ID=#{id} AND RECIPIENT_USER_ID=#{userId} AND READ_FLAG=0
